description.value: Yew Street Food Hall is a vibrant indoor food hall in Kamloops' North Shore neighbourhood, bringing together ten independent food and drink vendors under one roof. The eclectic vendor lineup spans Korean fried chicken, Vietnamese, Mexican, pasta, crepes, and craft beverages from local and regional producers. It's a community-focused culinary hub where a touring cyclist can choose from a wide variety of cuisines without committing to a single restaurant.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Yew Street Food Hall is an active 10-vendor food hall at 107 Yew St #1, Kamloops, with phone (778) 362-4141 matching the OSM record. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all such fields default to null per the absence-of-evidence rule. The postal code on the website (V2B 4A1) differs from the OSM record (V2B 3H3), flagged as a concern.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM has V2B 3H3, website consistently shows V2B 4A1.
OSM address omits unit number '#1' present on website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Yew Street Food Hall is a legitimate and active food destination well-suited for touring cyclists seeking diverse meal options, but no cyclist-facing amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) could be confirmed from the website. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify the minimum required criteria before including in the WWC directory.

wow_evidence: ten independent food and drink vendors under one roof
